github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Generate commit messages that pass this repository's commitlint configuration. Use Conventional Commits: <type>(<optional scope>): <subject>. Allowed types are feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, and revert. The type must be lowercase, the subject must be non-empty and must not end with a period, and the complete first line must be no more than 100 characters. Return only the commit message, with no Markdown fences or explanation.
